The expectation value is computed as \(\langle O \rangle = 10\langle \sigma_z \rangle + 5\langle \sigma_x \rangle\).  
Given \(|\psi\rangle = 0.5|\uparrow\rangle + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}|\downarrow\rangle\),  
\(\langle \sigma_z \rangle = |0.5|^2 - \left|\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right|^2 = 0.25 - 0.75 = -0.5\).  
\(\langle \sigma_x \rangle = 2 \operatorname{Re}(0.5^* \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}) = 2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx 0.8660\).  
Thus \(\langle O \rangle = 10(-0.5) + 5(0.8660) = -5 + 4.3301 = -0.6699 \approx -0.7\) to one decimal place.

Answer: A
